\section*{Chapter 32 - APIs Reference}


\subsection*{Purpose}

This chapter provides reference documentation for AIM-OS APIs including MCP tools, HTTP endpoints, and integration interfaces. APIs enable external systems to integrate with AIM-OS and access its capabilities.

\subsection*{Executive Summary}

\item AIM-OS provides 59 MCP tools for AI-to-AI communication and system integration.
\item HTTP endpoints enable external systems to access AIM-OS capabilities.
\item Integration interfaces enable seamless integration with existing systems.

\subsection*{MCP Tools Reference}

AIM-OS provides 59 MCP tools organized by category:

\subsubsection*{Core AIM-OS Tools (6)}
\item \texttt{store\_memory} - Store knowledge in CMC
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{content} (string), \texttt{tags} (array), \texttt{metadata} (object)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{atom\_id} (string), \texttt{timestamp} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Store chapter expansion insights
\item \texttt{retrieve\_memory} - Retrieve insights from HHNI
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{query} (string), \texttt{limit} (integer), \texttt{filters} (object)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{memories} (array), \texttt{count} (integer)
  - \textbf{Example:} Retrieve relevant insights for chapter expansion
\item \texttt{get\_memory\_stats} - Get AIM-OS statistics
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{include\_breakdown} (boolean)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{total\_atoms} (integer), \texttt{total\_snapshots} (integer), \texttt{breakdown} (object)
  - \textbf{Example:} Get memory system statistics
\item \texttt{create\_plan} - Create APOE execution plans
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{goal} (string), \texttt{context} (object), \texttt{priority} (string)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{plan\_id} (string), \texttt{steps} (array)
  - \textbf{Example:} Create plan for chapter expansion
\item \texttt{track\_confidence} - Track VIF confidence
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{task} (string), \texttt{confidence} (float), \texttt{evidence} (array)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{witness\_id} (string), \texttt{confidence} (float)
  - \textbf{Example:} Track confidence for chapter expansion
\item \texttt{synthesize\_knowledge} - Synthesize SEG knowledge
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{topics} (array), \texttt{depth} (string), \texttt{format} (string)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{synthesis} (object), \texttt{insights} (array)
  - \textbf{Example:} Synthesize knowledge from multiple sources

\subsubsection*{Timeline Context Tools (3)}
\item \texttt{add\_timeline\_entry} - Track context at each prompt
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{prompt\_id} (string), \texttt{user\_input} (string), \texttt{context\_state} (object)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{entry\_id} (string), \texttt{timestamp} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Track context for chapter expansion session
\item \texttt{get\_timeline\_summary} - Get recent timeline entries
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{limit} (integer)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{entries} (array), \texttt{count} (integer)
  - \textbf{Example:} Get recent context entries
\item \texttt{get\_timeline\_entries} - Query timeline history
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{start\_time} (string), \texttt{end\_time} (string), \texttt{limit} (integer)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{entries} (array), \texttt{count} (integer)
  - \textbf{Example:} Query timeline history for chapter expansion

\subsubsection*{Goal Timeline Tools (3)}
\item \texttt{create\_goal\_timeline\_node} - Create goals as timeline planning nodes
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{goal\_id} (string), \texttt{name} (string), \texttt{description} (string), \texttt{priority} (string)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{goal\_id} (string), \texttt{node\_id} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Create goal for chapter expansion
\item \texttt{update\_goal\_progress} - Update goal progress and status
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{goal\_id} (string), \texttt{progress} (float), \texttt{status} (string)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{goal\_id} (string), \texttt{updated\_progress} (float)
  - \textbf{Example:} Update goal progress for chapter expansion
\item \texttt{query\_goal\_timeline} - Query goals with filtering
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{status} (string), \texttt{priority} (string), \texttt{limit} (integer)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{goals} (array), \texttt{count} (integer)
  - \textbf{Example:} Query goals for chapter expansion

\subsubsection*{AI Collaboration Tools (6)}
\item \texttt{send\_ai\_message} - Send a message to another AI system
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{from\_ai} (string), \texttt{to\_ai} (string), \texttt{content} (string), \texttt{message\_type} (string)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{message\_id} (string), \texttt{thread\_id} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Send status update to Aether
\item \texttt{get\_ai\_messages} - Retrieve AI-to-AI messages
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{from\_ai} (string), \texttt{to\_ai} (string), \texttt{message\_type} (string), \texttt{limit} (integer)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{messages} (array), \texttt{count} (integer)
  - \textbf{Example:} Get messages from Aether
\item \texttt{start\_ai\_discussion} - Start a new discussion thread
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{from\_ai} (string), \texttt{to\_ai} (string), \texttt{topic} (string), \texttt{initial\_message} (string)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{thread\_id} (string), \texttt{message\_id} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Start discussion about chapter expansion
\item \texttt{handoff\_task\_to\_ai} - Hand off a task to another AI system
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{from\_ai} (string), \texttt{to\_ai} (string), \texttt{task\_description} (string), \texttt{task\_data} (object)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{handoff\_id} (string), \texttt{thread\_id} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Hand off chapter expansion to Codex
\item \texttt{share\_ai\_profile} - Share AI profile and capabilities
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{from\_ai} (string), \texttt{to\_ai} (string), \texttt{profile\_data} (object)
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{profile\_id} (string), \texttt{timestamp} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Share profile with other agents
\item \texttt{get\_ai\_collaboration\_summary} - Get summary of AI collaboration activity
  - \textbf{Parameters:} None
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{total\_messages} (integer), \texttt{active\_threads} (integer), \texttt{summary} (object)
  - \textbf{Example:} Get collaboration summary

\subsubsection*{Autonomous Protocol Tools (9)}
\item \texttt{start\_autonomous\_operation} - Start autonomous operation
  - \textbf{Parameters:} \texttt{task} (string), \texttt{confidence} (float)

  - \textbf{Example:} Resume autonomous operation
\item \texttt{stop\_autonomous\_operation} - Stop autonomous operation
  - \textbf{Parameters:} None
  - \textbf{Returns:} \texttt{status} (string)
  - \textbf{Example:} Stop autonomous operation
\item \texttt{get\_autonomous\_status} - Get current status
  - \textbf{Parameters:} None

\item \texttt{run\_autonomous\_checklist} - Run safety checklist
  - \textbf{Parameters:} None

  - \textbf{Example:} Run autonomous safety checklist

  - \textbf{Parameters:} None

\item \texttt{generate\_next\_autonomous\_task} - Generate next task

\subsection*{HTTP Endpoints Reference}

AIM-OS provides HTTP endpoints for external integration:

\subsubsection*{MCP Execute Endpoint}

\textbf{Endpoint:} \texttt{POST http://localhost:5001/mcp/execute}  
\textbf{Content-Type:} \texttt{application/json}

\textbf{Request Format:}
``\texttt{json
{
  "tool": "tool\_name",
  "arguments": {
    "param1": "value1",
    "param2": "value2"
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Response Format:}
}`\texttt{json
{
  "success": true,
  "result": {},
  "error": null
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Error Format:}
}`\texttt{json
{
  "success": false,
  "result": null,
  "error": {
    "code": "error\_code",
    "message": "Error message"
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Example Request:}
}`\texttt{json
{
  "tool": "store\_memory",
  "arguments": {
    "content": "AIM-OS enables AI consciousness",
    "tags": ["consciousness", "ai"]
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Example Response:}
}`\texttt{json
{
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "atom\_id": "atom\_12345",
    "timestamp": "2025-11-06T17:00:00Z"
  },
  "error": null
}
}`\texttt{

\subsubsection*{Health Check Endpoint}

\textbf{Endpoint:} }GET http://localhost:5001/health\texttt{  
\textbf{Method:} GET

\textbf{Response Format:}
}`\texttt{json
{
  "status": "healthy",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-06T17:00:00Z",
  "systems": {
    "cmc": "healthy",
    "hhni": "healthy",
    "vif": "healthy"
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Status Values:}
\item }healthy\texttt{ - All systems operational
\item }degraded\texttt{ - Some systems degraded
\item }unhealthy\texttt{ - Critical systems failing

\subsubsection*{Metrics Endpoint}

\textbf{Endpoint:} }GET http://localhost:5001/metrics\texttt{  
\textbf{Method:} GET

\textbf{Response Format:}
}`\texttt{json
{
  "memory": {
    "total\_atoms": 10000,
    "total\_snapshots": 500
  },
  "performance": {
    "avg\_latency\_ms": 50,
    "p95\_latency\_ms": 80
  },
  "collaboration": {
    "total\_messages": 141,
    "active\_threads": 5
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\subsubsection*{MCP List Endpoint}

\textbf{Endpoint:} }GET http://localhost:5001/mcp/list\texttt{  
\textbf{Method:} GET

\textbf{Response Format:}
}`\texttt{json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "store\_memory",
      "description": "Store knowledge in CMC",
      "parameters": {}
    }
  ],
  "count": 59
}
}`\texttt{

\subsection*{Integration Points}

APIs integrate deeply with all AIM-OS systems:

\subsubsection*{APOE (Chapter 8)}

\textbf{APOE provides:} Orchestration for API calls  
\textbf{APIs provide:} Tool execution requiring orchestration  
\textbf{Integration:} APOE orchestrates API calls with quality gates and budgets

\textbf{Key Insight:} APOE enables orchestration. APIs use APOE for workflow orchestration.

\subsubsection*{VIF (Chapter 7)}

\textbf{VIF provides:} Confidence tracking for API operations  
\textbf{APIs provide:} Operations requiring confidence tracking  
\textbf{Integration:} VIF tracks confidence for all API operations

\textbf{Key Insight:} VIF enables confidence tracking. APIs use VIF for operation confidence.

\subsubsection*{CCS (Chapter 13)}

\textbf{CCS provides:} Real-time communication for APIs  
\textbf{APIs provide:} Communication requiring real-time substrate  
\textbf{Integration:} CCS enables real-time API communication

\textbf{Key Insight:} CCS enables real-time communication. APIs use CCS for communication substrate.

\subsubsection*{CMC (Chapter 5)}

\textbf{CMC provides:} Persistent storage for API operations  
\textbf{APIs provide:} Operations requiring storage  
\textbf{Integration:} CMC stores all API operation history

\textbf{Key Insight:} CMC enables persistence. APIs use CMC for operation storage.

\textbf{Overall Insight:} APIs integrate with all systems to enable comprehensive AIM-OS access. Every system contributes to API functionality.
